images.description: Jalen Brunson hits a series-clinching, 25-foot 3-pointer with 4.3 seconds remaining in Game 6 to defeat the Detroit Pistons 116-113, advancing the Knicks to the second round. The star guard finished with 40, after creating the separation needed to bury the shot.

Anthony Edwards rises up for a highlight slam in Game 3 of the Western Conference Finals against the Oklahoma City Thunder. Edwards finished with 30, pushing the Timberwolves past OKC for a blowout win.

Denver Nuggets Forward Corey Brewer makes the most of his shot at NBA glory against the Rockets, seizing the opportunity for more playing time with teammate Danilo Gallinari going down for the season.
Pistons All Star Jalen Duren and Hornets Moussa Diabate sqaure off, leading to punches thrown by Miles Brides and Isiah Stewart. All 4 players were handed suspensions after the altercation.
